dashboard.modal_auth_intro: Please perform the login process inside the newly spawned black command terminal (CMD) window and web browser.
dashboard.modal_auth_step1: Copy the OAuth URL link printed inside the CMD window and open it in a new web browser tab if it does not open automatically.
dashboard.modal_auth_step2: Review the Evernote 'Re-authorize Bulk Backup' permissions page and click the [Re-authorize] button.
dashboard.modal_auth_step3: Once the browser screen displays 'Authentication successful!', you can safely close the browser tab.
dashboard.modal_auth_step4: Return to the backup console window and close the CMD window by pressing any key.
